title: harnessed service
description: A sidecar service definition (catalog/services/<name>/service.yaml). Its own image and container, with a lifecycle independent of any instance. A recipe references it via mcp.servers[].service; a stack attaches a non-MCP sidecar via its services: list. See docs/harnessed-design.md §3/§9.

name.description: Service identity. For scope: global, unique by name (e.g. hindsight) — reached via host.containers.internal:<port>. For scope: project, one container per project (git-common-dir keyed).

image.description: The container image tag for this service (e.g. harnessed-ping:latest).

scope.description: global (default): ONE shared container, host-published, reached at host.containers.internal:<port>. project: one container PER PROJECT (keyed by git-common-dir), whose data dir is the project's own persist entry — used when a service holds an exclusive on-disk lock over per-project data (e.g. a dolt sql-server).

port.description: The host-published port the service listens on (1–65535). Peers reach it at host.containers.internal:<port>. Required unless `socket` is set (socket-only services publish no port).

socket.description: Unix socket path RELATIVE to the service's data dir (e.g. run/mysql.sock). When set, the service publishes NO host port: peers reach it through the socket, which rides the shared bind-mount as a filesystem object — no network namespace, no port allocation. Requires scope: project.

data.description: For scope: project — where this service's data dir comes from. Instead of a named volume, the launcher bind-mounts the host dir behind a persist entry declared by whichever recipe in the stack owns it, so the SERVICE follows the RECIPE's placement choice (in_repo vs host).

persist.description: Name of the persist entry (declared by a recipe in the stack) whose host dir is bind-mounted as this service's data dir at /data (e.g. .beads).

volume.description: Service-scoped, harness-independent named volume (defaults to <name>-data), mounted at /data. Only for scope: global — a project-scoped service uses `data:` instead.

healthcheck.description: Shell command used as the container healthcheck (e.g. curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1).

sync.description: Shell command run INSIDE the service container by `harnessed svc sync <name>`. For a dolt sql-server this is `bd dolt push`: bd's git sync shells out to the dolt CLI, which only routes to a server on its own loopback, so the push cannot run from an agent container. Never automatic — it writes to your git remote.
